Publication of Annual Report and Audited Financial Statements

The Annual Report and Audited Financial Statements for the financial year ended 30 April 2026 for HSBC Global Liquidity Funds plc have been published. A copy of the Annual Report has been submitted to the National Storage Mechanism and will shortly be available for inspection at https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism and on the HSBC Global Liquidity Funds website at http://www.assetmanagement.hsbc.com
